notes: 静态向量；本轮不执行。用于冻结 TS 进程内 server 与 host Unrouted 的现状，并为 host front door 目标留门。

vectors.title: 当前 serve/web/TUI worker 仍通过 Server.listen 进程内启动
vectors.command:
set -euo pipefail
for f in packages/chimera/src/cli/cmd/serve.ts packages/chimera/src/cli/cmd/web.ts packages/chimera/src/cli/cmd/tui/worker.ts; do grep -q "Server.listen" "$f"; done
echo "in-process server boot confirmed"

vectors.title: host bin 仍是 Unrouted，所有请求返回 not_implemented
vectors.command:
grep -q "struct Unrouted" chimera-host/src/bin/chimera-host.rs
grep -q "request routing is not wired" chimera-host/src/bin/chimera-host.rs
echo "unrouted confirmed"

vectors.title: host 源码没有 HTTP listener
vectors.command:
if rg -n "TcpListener|HttpServer|hyper::Server|axum::" chimera-host/src >/dev/null; then echo "http found"; exit 1; fi
echo "no host http listener"

vectors.title: host front door 启动后 /global/health 返回 healthy
vectors.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$(mktemp -d)"
port="${PORT:?set PORT to a free local port}"
host_bin="${HOST_BIN:-chimera-host/target/debug/chimera-host}"
test -x "$host_bin"
CHIMERA_HOST_HTTP_PORT="$port" "$host_bin" "$root" --db "$root/host.db" >"$root/out" 2>"$root/err" &
pid=$!
trap 'kill -TERM "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true; wait "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true; rm -rf "$root"' EXIT
for i in $(seq 1 50); do if curl -fsS "http://localhost:$port/global/health" >"$root/health" 2>/dev/null; then break; fi; sleep 0.2; done
grep -q '"healthy":true' "$root/health"
printf 'health=ok\n'
vectors.cleanup: trap 终止 host 并删除临时目录
vectors.notes: CHIMERA_HOST_HTTP_PORT 是目标契约的候选 env；实现时需在 boot-path-capability 中冻结。
